blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Privacy has become an increasingly important concern in the Document Analysis community, to the extent that in many environments such as archives, governmental institutions, and local businesses, the adoption of automation is restricted by legal and policy constraints. While federated learning has often been regarded as a “necessary evil”, implying an unavoidable performance trade-off in exchange for decentralization and privacy, many prior works overlook its potential to improve robustness to out-of-distribution data. In this paper, we present Unapologetically Distributed, the first comprehensive study evaluating distributed learning in Document Analysis along three key axes simultaneously: the tasks addressed, the architectures employed, and the fine-tuning strategies applied. Specifically, we demonstrate how various distributed training approaches enhance generalization capabilities across diverse tasks such as Table Recognition, handwriting recognition, and Word Spotting, particularly during transfer learning stages. Our results provide strong evidence that decentralization is not merely a constraint, but a valuable opportunity to improve model robustness and adaptability in real-world Document Analysis scenarios.
blocks.zh: 隐私已成为文件分析界日益重要的关注事项,因为在档案、政府机构和地方企业等许多环境中,自动化的采用受到法律和政策限制。 虽然联邦学习往往被视为一种“必要的罪恶”,这意味着不可避免的业绩取舍,以换取权力下放和隐私,但许多先前的工作忽略了提高分配外数据的稳健性的潜力。 在本文中,我们介绍了Uniapologetical Discriptioned,这是第一个综合研究,它评估了文件分析中围绕三个关键轴线进行的分布式学习:所处理的任务、所采用的结构以及所采用的微调战略。 具体地说,我们展示了各种分布式培训方法如何加强诸如表识别、笔迹识别和Word Spotting等不同任务的一般化能力,特别是在转移学习阶段。 我们的成果有力地证明,权力下放不仅是一种制约因素,而且是在现实世界文件分析设想中改进模式稳健性和适应性的宝贵机会。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: In many Document Analysis scenarios, the assumptions underlying centralized machine learning pipelines are difficult to satisfy. Training modern deep models typically relies on large-scale data aggregation and expensive computational infrastructures, a strategy that has raised growing concerns regarding data privacy and information leakage [ Carlini et al.(2023)Carlini, Hayes, Nasr, Jagielski, Sehwag, Tramer, Balle, Ippolito, and Wallace ] . These issues are particularly critical for document data, which frequently contains sensitive, personal, legal, or historical information. As a result, centralization is often impractical or undesirable, despite the availability of valuable training material. This limitation is especially evident in contexts involving privately owned administrative records. Additionally, cultural heritage institutions have long emphasized the importance of preserving documents close to their place of origin, as this practice safeguards their contextual integrity [ Brothman(2001) ] , authenticity, and cultural significance [ Ketelaar(2005) ] , while also aligning with distributed preservation strategies [ Olliff and Dill(2021) ] . Similarly, small and medium-sized enterprises routinely handle confidential documents but lack the resources or legal capacity to externalize data labeling or participate in centralized training schemes. In all cases, the inability to pool data significantly limits the applicability of conventional learning approaches.
blocks.zh: 在许多文件分析设想中,集中式机器学习管道所依据的假设难以满足. 现代深层模型的培训通常依赖于大规模的数据汇总和昂贵的计算基础设施,这一策略引起了对数据隐私和信息泄漏的日益关注[Carlini等人(2023年),Hayes, Nasr, Jagielski, Sehwag, Tramer, Balle, Ippolito, 和Wallace]. 这些问题对于文件数据特别重要,因为文件数据往往包含敏感、个人、法律或历史信息。 因此,中央集权往往不切实际或不可取,尽管有宝贵的培训材料。 在涉及私人拥有的行政记录的情况下,这种限制特别明显。 此外,文化遗产机构长期以来一直强调保存靠近其原产地的文件的重要性,因为这种做法维护了其背景完整性[Brothman(2001年)]、真实性和文化意义[Ketelaar(2005年)],同时也符合分布式保存战略[Olliff和Dill(2021)]。 同样,中小型企业通常处理机密文件,但缺乏资源或法律能力,无法将数据贴上标签或参与集中培训计划。 在所有情况下,无法汇集数据极大地限制了常规学习方法的适用性。

blocks.en: Distributed learning provides a natural alternative by enabling collaborative model training without direct data sharing, more precisely in our case through post-hoc model merging, where independently trained models are aggregated at the parameter level. However, their adoption in Document Analysis has been hindered by concerns regarding robustness under non-identically distributed data, a setting in which performance degradation has been widely reported [ Matsuda et al.(2022)Matsuda, Sasaki, Xiao, and Onizuka ] . At the same time, insights from personalized and meta-learning suggest that distributed training can remain effective when local heterogeneity is explicitly accounted for [ Arivazhagan et al.(2019)Arivazhagan, Aggarwal, Singh, and Choudhary ] . This work builds on these observations and investigates distributed learning as a practical and effective solution for Document Analysis in privacy-constrained and low-resource environments.
blocks.zh: 分布式学习提供了一种自然的替代方法,在不直接分享数据的情况下提供协作模式培训,更确切地说,在我们的案例中,通过Hoc后模式合并,将经过独立培训的模式汇总到参数一级。 然而,在文件分析中,由于人们担心在不相同分布的数据下,这种数据很坚固,因而妨碍了其通过。 与此同时,从个性化和元学习中得出的见解表明,当明确说明当地异质性时,分布式培训仍然有效[Arivazhagan等人(2019年),Arivazhagan、Aggarwal、Singh和Choudhary]。 这项工作以这些观察为基础,并调查了分布式学习,将其作为在隐私受限和资源有限的环境中进行文件分析的一个切实有效的解决办法。

blocks.en:
Our research hypothesis is threefold:
(i) following model merging principles, features learned by distributed models should be more generalizable and thus serve as better teachers in knowledge distillation;
(ii) these features should be sufficiently general to enable multi-script learning, even when data distributions differ significantly from the original training data; and
(iii) the resulting models should provide superior initializations for subsequent in-distribution finetuning stages.

The contribution of this work is to present a large-scale empirical and analytical study of decentralized training in Document Analysis, examining when and why simple model merging strategies yield consistent benefits (see Figure 1 ). Our analysis is structured along three complementary axes: architectural families, task types, and data regimes. We evaluate distributed pre-training across a diverse set of representative tasks which, when considered jointly, cover a broad and practically relevant spectrum of use cases in Document Analysis. By controlling computational budgets, we isolate the effect of decentralized training and characterize the conditions under which it provides measurable advantages. Our objective is not to advocate decentralization as a universal solution, but to characterize the regimes in which it is most effective. In particular, we identify the conditions under which decentralized learning delivers competitive or superior performance; most notably in low-resource, distribution-shifted, and operationally constrained scenarios that frequently arise in real-world Document Analysis applications. To this end, we conduct an extensive evaluation comprising:

blocks.en: To the best of our knowledge, this article represents the first comprehensive evaluation of distributed learning in Document Analysis that simultaneously considers multiple dimensions: the specific tasks being addressed, the underlying neural architectures employed, and the strategies used for fine-tuning. By systematically examining these aspects, we provide a holistic understanding of how distributedly learned models perform across diverse Document Analysis scenarios and highlight the conditions under which distributed learning provides tangible benefits over centralized approaches.
blocks.zh: 就我们所知,这篇文章是对文件分析中分布式学习的第一次全面评估,同时考虑了多个层面:正在处理的具体任务、所采用的基本神经结构以及用于微调的战略。 通过系统地审查这些方面,我们全面了解分布式学习模式如何在各种文件分析情景中发挥作用,并强调分布式学习在何种条件下比集中式方法提供实际好处。

blocks.en:
In [ Zhang(2020) ] , a representative example of distributed OCR, the authors note that “ Expectantly, our FedOCR achieves comparable results, which are very close to the results of the centralized training manner ,” a formulation that frames federated learning as an approximation of centralized training rather than a standalone paradigm. In their seminal contributions such as [ He et al.(2021)He, Balasubramanian, Ceyani, Yang, Xie, Sun, He, Yang, Yu, Rong, et al. ] , where distributed learning is applied to Graph Neural Network architectures, the conclusions are drawn in the same direction.
In recent years, some works have started to point out that distributedly learned systems may hold significant potential for subsequent fine-tuning strategies. This is the case in [ Nguyen and Karatzas(2024) ] , a pilot study on federated Document Visual Question Answering, where the authors report the outperformance of the centralized regime (C=1, K=1 in their setting, where C denotes the client sampling probability and K the number of participating clients) while also observing that their federated approach achieves comparable results with smaller models in later fine-tuning stages. Nevertheless, the broader implications and global potential of federated learning are not explicitly emphasized. To the best of our knowledge, no prior study has addressed the task of federated learning for Table Recognition, a notable gap given the sensitivity of such data in modern industrial settings.
blocks.zh:
[Zhang(2020年)]是分布式OCR的典型例子,作者指出,“期望我们的FEDOCR取得相当的结果,这些结果与集中式培训方式的结果非常接近,”一种将联邦式学习作为集中式培训的近似而非独立模式的框架。 在他们的重要贡献中,如[He等人(2021年)He,Balasubramanian,Ceyani,杨,谢,孙, 他,杨 Yu, Rong, et al.],分布式学习应用到图神经网络架构中,结论是朝同一方向得出的.
近年来,一些著作开始指出,分布式学习的系统有可能为随后的微调战略带来巨大潜力. 例如[Nguyen and Karatzas(2024)],关于联邦文件视觉问答的试点研究,作者报告集中制的超效情况(C=1,K=1,C表示客户采样概率,K表示参与客户数量),同时也观察到其联邦方法在后来的微调阶段用较小的模型取得可比的结果. 然而,联邦学习的更广泛影响和全球潜力没有得到明确强调。 据我们所知,以前没有一项研究涉及为表识别而联合学习的任务,鉴于现代工业环境中这些数据的敏感性,这是一个显著的差距。

blocks.en:
In summary, this work is contextualized as the first to holistically demonstrate the potential of distributed learning in Document Analysis across multiple tasks and architectures, while also being the first to perform distributed learning for Table Recognition and knowledge distillation from federatedly learned Document Analysis Systems.
In this paper, readers may find similarities to Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning [ Jiang et al.(2019)Jiang, Konečnỳ, Rush, and Kannan ] , Model Soups [ Wortsman et al.(2022)Wortsman, Ilharco, Gadre, Roelofs, Gontijo-Lopes, Morcos, Namkoong, Farhadi, Carmon, Kornblith, et al. ] , Model Editing with Task Arithmetic [ Ilharco et al.(2023)Ilharco, Ribeiro, Wortsman, Schmidt, Hajishirzi, and Farhadi ] , and Federated Learning through FedAvg [ McMahan et al.(2023)McMahan, Moore, Ramage, Hampson, and y Arcas ] , depending on their background. We argue that all of the methods above can be treated similarly with regard to their capacity for distributed learning, in the sense that models trained across different computing units can be aggregated without sharing data.

简言之,这项工作的背景是第一个全面展示在文件分析中跨越多个任务和架构的分布式学习的潜力,同时也是第一个从联合学习的文件分析系统中为表格识别和知识提炼进行分布式学习。
在本文中,读者可能会发现与Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning [Jiang等人(2019年) Jiang, Konečnỳ, Rush, and Kannan], Model Soups [Wortsman等人(2022年) Wortsman, Ilharco, Gadre, Roelofs, Gontijo-Lopes, Morcos, Namkoong, Farhadi, Carmon, Kornblith, et al.]相似之处. , 配有任务算术的模型编辑 [Ilharco et al.(2023)Ilharco, Ribeiro, Wortsman, Schmidt, Hajishirzi, and Farhadi], 和联邦通过FedAvg [McMahan et al.(2023)McMahan, Moore, Ramage, Hampson, and y Arcas], 视其背景而定. 我们主张,上述所有方法在分布式学习能力方面可以作类似的处理,因为不同计算单元中培训的模型可以汇总,而不分享数据。

blocks.en: In contrast to FedAvg, we do not conduct multiple federated rounds. In contrast to MAML, our dataset splits are domain-specific, emulating different institutions. Perhaps the closest related approaches are model editing and model soups; however, neither focuses on the ability of distributedly learned models to incorporate personalized, out-of-domain data. Furthermore, to the best of our knowledge, no prior model soup work has conducted such an extensive evaluation across different architectures, datasets, and application domains.
blocks.zh: 与FedAvg相对,我们不进行多轮联赛. 相对于MAML,我们的数据集分割是针对特定域的,模仿不同的机构. 也许最直接相关的方法是模型编辑和模型汤;然而,两者都不注重分布式学习模型纳入个性化,域外数据的能力. 此外,据我们所知,没有一项先前的模型汤工作对不同的架构、数据集和应用领域进行了如此广泛的评估。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: In this study, we aim to evaluate distributed learning holistically across Document Analysis tasks. Specifically, we conduct experiments under three training strategies: knowledge distillation, layer-wise fine-tuning, and end-to-end fine-tuning. This design allows us to assess whether distributedly learned models exhibit higher generality than their centralized counterparts across different Document Analysis scenarios. To support this claim, it is first necessary to clearly define the three methodological settings considered in this work.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们的目标是从整体上评价文件分析任务的分布式学习。 具体来说,我们在三种训练策略下进行实验:知识蒸馏,层层微调,端到端微调. 这一设计使我们能够评估,在不同的文件分析设想中,分布式学习的模型是否比集中的模型更加笼统。 为支持这一主张,首先必须明确界定这项工作中考虑的三种方法背景。

blocks.en: Given the broad audience targeted by this study, we begin by introducing the fundamentals of our model merging strategy. Following the notation introduced in [ Ilharco et al.(2023)Ilharco, Ribeiro, Wortsman, Schmidt, Hajishirzi, and Farhadi ] , we present the principles of model merging in Section 3.1 . Readers already familiar with the FedAvg algorithm and the concept of task vectors may directly refer to Section 3.2 , where we detail the specific methodological choices of this study, namely the three fine-tuning strategies evaluated.

blocks.en: 3.2 Finetuning Strategy
blocks.zh: 3.2 微调战略

blocks.en: In this section, three methodological approaches are proposed to verify the hypothesis that distributedly trained models exhibit superior learning capabilities during the fine-tuning stage . Specifically, we investigate: (i) knowledge distillation from a frozen encoder in a Word Spotting task; (ii) layer-wise fine-tuning strategies for handwritten text recognition (HTR) and optical character recognition (OCR) problems when adapting models to new alphabets; and (iii) graph-based Table Recognition using end-to-end fine-tuned models. Through these approaches, we aim to present a broad and transversal methodology that encompasses a wide range of use cases, architectures, and training strategies, thereby providing a robust and empirical validation of the proposed hypothesis.
blocks.zh: 本节提出了三种方法,以核实在微调阶段经分布式培训的模型表现出较高学习能力的假设。 具体来说,我们调查:(一) Word Spoting任务中冷冻编码器的知识蒸馏;(二) 手写文字识别(HTR)和光学字符识别(OCR)问题的分层微调策略,在将模型适应新字母表时;和(三) 采用端到端微调模型的图表表识别. 通过这些办法,我们力求提出一种广泛和横向的方法,涵盖广泛的使用案例、架构和培训战略,从而对拟议假设提供有力和经验验证。

blocks.en:
Knowledge distillation is the training strategy consisting in transfering information from a base network (teacher), which is usually trained with high computational and data resources, to a smaller (student) network.
For this task, we aim to leverage the information of a frozen vision encoder into a small text encoder to perform a Query-by-String evaluation of a Word Spotting system. According to our hypothesis, distributed models should behave better as teachers due to its higher generalization capability.
blocks.zh:
知识蒸馏(英語:Knowledge distractation)是培训策略,包括将信息从通常接受高计算和数据资源培训的基网(教师)转移到一个较小的(学生)网络.
为了完成这项任务,我们的目标是利用一个冷冻的视觉编码器的信息进入一个小的文本编码器,对Word Spoting系统进行逐条的查询评价. 根据我们的假设,分布式模型由于具有较高的通俗化能力,应该表现得更好.

blocks.en:
As seen in Figure 2 , different off-the-shelf OCR models from [ Molina Rodríguez et al.(2025)Molina Rodríguez, Ramos Terrades, and Lladós ] are sampled as Vision Encoders dedicated to both scene and handwritten text recognition. After removing the language layer, we perform model merging (see Equation 3 ) to obtain a distributedly learnt feature extractor (i.e. an extractor for which the different training datasets are not shared). Then, given a target dataset (the one we want to perform distillation on), visual embeddings are computed.
For the textual embeddings, we make use of standard bidirectional Recurrent Neural Networks (LSTM [ Hochreiter and Schmidhuber(1997) ] and GRU [ Chung et al.(2014)Chung, Gulcehre, Cho, and Bengio ] ) and a transformer encoder architecture [ Atienza(2021) ] . In all the cases, the text encoder is computed by adding a special <RET> token in the last position. The distance between textual and vision embeddings are minimized through a Triplet Margin Loss [ Balntas et al.()Balntas, Riba, Ponsa, and Mikolajczyk ] , transferring in consequence the spatial distribution of the visual embeddings into the text encoder.
blocks.zh:
如图2所示,与[Molina Rodríguez et al.(2025) Molina Rodríguez, Ramos Terrades, 和Lladós]不同的现成OCR模型被取样为Vision Encoders, 专门用于现场和手写文本识别。 在移除语言层后,我们进行模型合并(见方程式3),以获得分布式学习的特征提取器(即不共享不同训练数据集的提取器). 然后,给一个目标数据集(我们想要在其中进行蒸馏),可以计算出视觉嵌入。
对于文字嵌入,我们使用标准的双向经常性神经网络(LSTM [Hochreiter and Schmidhuber(1997)]和GRU[Chung et al.(2014)Chung, Gulcehre, Cho, and Bengio))和一个变压器编码器架构[Atienza(2021)]. 在所有情况下,文本编码器都是通过在最后一个位置添加一个特殊的“RET”符号来计算的。 通过Triplet Margin Loss[Baltas等人()Baltas、Riba、Ponsa和Mikolajczyk],将文字嵌入和视觉嵌入之间的距离最小化,从而将视觉嵌入在文字编码器中的空间分布转移。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Knowledge distillation scheme: multiple pretrained OCRs are combined into a frozen teacher, which guides an RNN to map text to images in unseen alphabets or domains.
blocks.zh: 图2 知识蒸馏计划:多次预训 OCR合并成一个冷冻的老师,指导一个RNN将文本映射到隐形字母或域中的图像.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Distributed models trained on Latin alphabets are evaluated on unseen scripts by averaging backbones and fine-tuning only the language head.
blocks.zh: 图3:通过平均主干线和仅微调语言头来评价在拉丁字母上培训的分布式模型。

blocks.en: In a personalized learning framework, the goal is for a federated model to effectively incorporate new data, typically through layer-wise fine-tuning. In this section, we adopt a standard Vision Transformer (ViT) architecture as our reference model (see [ Atienza(2021) ] ), pre-trained on the HierText dataset [ Long et al.(2022)Long, Qin, Panteleev, Bissacco, Fujii, and Raptis ] . This model serves as our baseline .
blocks.zh: 在一个个性化的学习框架内,目标是联合模型有效地纳入新的数据,通常是通过分层微调。 本节采用标准Vision Transformer(ViT)架构作为我们的参考模型(见[Atienza(2021)]),在HierText数据集上进行预训[Long et al.(2022)Long, Qin, Panteleev, Bissacco, Fujii, and Raptis]. 这个模型是我们的基准。

blocks.en: Starting from this baseline, we conduct pre-training using a collection of datasets described in Section 4.1 . Two training paradigms are considered: (i) a centralized setting, where all datasets are combined and used to train a single model, and (ii) a distributed setting, where separate models are trained on individual datasets and later merged through model merging.
blocks.zh: 从这一基线开始,我们使用第4.1节所述数据集进行预训。 考虑两个训练范式: (一)集中设置,将所有数据集合并起来,用于训练单一模型; (二)分布设置,将单独的模型训练在单个数据集上,然后通过模型合并进行合并.

blocks.en: Since all pre-training datasets predominantly contain Latin characters (along with arabic numerals), we frame the recognition of an entirely new alphabet as a personalized learning task. Specifically, we perform personalized fine-tuning on ciphered and multilingual datasets (see Section 4.1 ), using limited data and a small number of epochs, and restricting updates to the later stages of the network. As shown in Figure 3 , to accommodate the new alphabet, the OCR language modeling head is replaced with a single layer whose output dimension matches the size of the new character dictionary.
blocks.zh: 由于所有预训数据集主要包含拉丁字母(与阿拉伯数字并列),因此我们把完全新字母的识别设定为个性化的学习任务. 具体地说,我们对密码和多语种数据集进行个性化的微调(见第4.1节),利用有限的数据和少量的时代,并将更新限制在网络的后期阶段. 如图3所示,为适应新的字母表,OCR语言建模头被替换为单层,其输出维度与新字符词典的大小相符.

blocks.en: Under our hypothesis, the distributed pre-training approach should enable the model to incorporate personalized data more effectively, resulting in improved recognition performance compared to the centralized model, when trained under identical hyperparameter settings and number of epochs.
blocks.zh: 根据我们的假设,如果在相同的超参数设置和历程数下接受培训,分布式培训前方法应能使模型更有效地纳入个性化数据,从而比集中模型提高识别性能。

blocks.en: Additionally, we report results for experiments that do not rely on HierText pre-training. In this alternative setup, models are initialized randomly (using the same seed for both centralized and distributed approaches), trained independently on each dataset, and subsequently merged via model merging in the distributed case.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们报告不依赖HierText预训的实验结果。 在这种备选设置中,模型被随机初始化(对集中式和分布式方法使用相同的种子),在每个数据集上独立训练,然后通过分布式的模型合并合并.

blocks.en: We also include experiments regarding End-to-End training of Graph Neural Networks in the context of Table Recognition; where, as seen in [ Riba et al.(2022)Riba, Goldmann, Terrades, Rusticus, Fornés, and Lladós ] , we consider text regions in a document as nodes consisting of their ( x 1 , y 1 , x 2 , y 2 ) (x_{1},y_{1},x_{2},y_{2}) coordinates and a vector class consisting of a histogram of the alphanumeric characters of the OCR text as node features. Then, a visibility graph is constructed with edges connecting adjacent nodes. The objective of the message passing algorithm is to classify each node as table, non-table or header categories only from its geometry, connectivity and the histogram of characters. For further details on the graph construction we refer readers to the cited original implementation.
blocks.zh: 在表格识别中,我们还将图神经网络的端到端训练实验纳入其中;从[Riba等人(2022年)Riba、Goldmann、Terrades、Rusticus、Fornés和Lladós]中可以看出,我们将文件的文本区域视为由它们(x 1, y 1, x 2, y 2) (x_{1}, y_{1}, x_{2}, y_{2})坐标和由OCR文本字母直方图构成的矢量类作为节点特征。 然后,用边缘连接邻近的节点来构建一个能见度图. 消息传递算法的目标是将每个节点分类为表,非表或头类,仅从其几何,连接和字符直方图中进行. 关于图表构造的进一步细节,我们请读者参看所引用的原始执行。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: The employed pre-training and fine-tuning datasets, as well as the evaluation setup, are defined in this section. When referring to a fine-tuning dataset, we denote the process in which a model, after being pre-trained using either a centralized or distributed strategy, is fine-tuned on that dataset individually. The effectiveness of the fine-tuning stage is then assessed using the corresponding test partition of the same dataset.
blocks.zh: 本节界定了所使用的培训前和微调数据集以及评价设置。 在提到一个微调数据集时,我们指的是一个模型在使用集中或分布式战略经过预先培训后,对该数据集进行个别微调的过程。 然后使用同一数据集的相应测试分区来评估微调阶段的有效性.

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: In this Section, we list the different 27 employed datasets and the rationale behind the choice of each of them. For a comprehensive summary of the datasets and tasks used for this study reader may refer to Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们列出了不同的27个使用数据集,以及选择每个数据集的理由。 关于本研究所用数据集和任务的综合摘要,读者可参见表1。

blocks.en: For the Word Spotting task, we first train an encoder which, as introduced in the methodology section, serves as a frozen teacher within a knowledge distillation framework. This encoder is trained using what we define as in-domain HTR and OCR datasets, which share a common Latin alphabet and consist of well-cropped, centered text samples with limited font variability.
blocks.zh: 对于Word Spoting任务,我们首先培训一个编码器,如方法部分所介绍的那样,它作为一个知识蒸馏框架内的冷冻教师. 这个编码器是使用我们定义的域内HTR和OCR数据集来训练的,这些数据集共用一个通用的拉丁字母表,由精密的,中央的文本样本组成,字体可变性有限.

blocks.en: Specifically, the handwritten text datasets include IAM [ Marti and Bunke(2002) ] , Esposalles [ Romero et al.(2013)Romero, Fornés, Serrano, Sánchez, Toselli, Frinken, Vidal, and Lladós ] , George Washington and Parzival [ Fischer et al.(2012)Fischer, Keller, Frinken, and Bunke ] , while the scene text datasets comprise CoCoText [ Veit et al.(2016)Veit, Matera, Neumann, Matas, and Belongie ] and the Latin split of MLT19 [ Nayef et al.(2019)Nayef, Patel, Busta, Chowdhury, Karatzas, Khlif, Matas, Pal, Burie, Liu, et al. ] . Due to their limited contribution to the overall training corpus (stemming from their reduced size and narrow scope) the SVT [ Wang et al.(2011)Wang, Babenko, and Belongie ] and IIIT5K [ Mishra et al.(2012)Mishra, Alahari, and Jawahar ] datasets are excluded from the training process and instead used as control variables to evaluate performance on unseen yet still in-domain datasets.
blocks.zh: 具体来说,手写文本数据集包括IAM[Marti and Bunke(2002)],Esposalles. [Romero等人(2013年)、Romero、Fornés、Serrano、Sánchez、Toselli、Frinken、Vidal和Lladós]、George Washington和Parzival[Fischer等人(2012年)Fischer、Keller、Frinken和Bunke],而现场文本数据集则包括Co CoCoTex[Veit等人(2016年)Veit、Matera、Neumann、Matas和Oultie]和MLT19的拉丁分集[Nayef等人(2019年)Nayef、Patel、Busta、Chowardhury、Karatzas、Khlif、Matas、Pal、Burie、Lu等人] 由于SVT[Wang et al.(2011)Wang、Babenko和Onitie]和IIIT5K[Mishra et al.(2012)Mishra、Alahari和Jawahar]数据集对总体培训大纲的贡献有限(从其缩小规模和缩小范围中抽取),因此,数据集被排除在培训进程之外,而是用作控制变量,用以评价在无形的但仍在域内的数据集上的表现。

blocks.en: Subsequently, knowledge from the trained vision encoder is distilled into a text encoder for the Query-by-String Word Spotting task. We define the Historical Maps [ Weinman et al.(2019)Weinman, Chen, Gafford, Gifford, Lamsal, and Niehus-Staab ] , SROIE [ Karatzas et al.(2013)Karatzas, Shafait, Uchida, Iwamura, i Bigorda, Mestre, Mas, Mota, Almazan, and De Las Heras ] , and FUNSD [ Jaume et al.()Jaume, Ekenel, and Thiran ] datasets as out-of-domain due to the presence of printed artifacts acting as background distractors in word images. Similarly, the WordArt dataset [ Xie et al.(2024)Xie, Deng, Zhang, Wang, and Liu ] and TotalText [ Ch’ng et al.(2020)Ch’ng, Chan, and Liu ] are considered out-of-domain because of their inclusion of artistic and highly variable fonts. The AMR dataset [ Laroca and et.al(2019) ] is also employed as a fine-tuning dataset, motivated by the presence of glares and visual artifacts that partially occlude textual information. In addition to the aforementioned out-of-domain datasets containing primarily Latin characters, we further incorporate the Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, and Bangla partitions of MLT19 [ Nayef et al.(2019)Nayef, Patel, Busta, Chowdhury, Karatzas, Khlif, Matas, Pal, Burie, Liu, et al. ] as both out-of-domain and out-of-vocabulary fine-tuning datasets, representing the most challenging scenario for knowledge distillation. Finally, the Copiale [ Knight et al.(2011)Knight, Megyesi, and Schaefer ] , Borg [ Aldarrab et al.()Aldarrab, Knight, and Megyesi ] , and Vatican cipher datasets [ Héder and Megyesi(2022) ] are included under the same rationale, as they introduce previously unseen symbol systems and vocabularies. We report the performance of this fine-tuning strategy across all previously described datasets, including in-domain, out-of-domain Latin, and out-of-domain out-of-vocabulary scenarios. For each dataset, a different model and independent is fine-tuned for ten epochs and evaluated on the corresponding test partition.
blocks.zh: 随后,从训练有素的视觉编码器中获取的知识被蒸馏成一个文本编码器,用于Query-by-String Word Spoting任务. 我们定义历史地图[Weinman et al.(2019)Weinman、陈、Gafford、Gifford、Lamsal和Niehus-Staab]、SROIE[Karatzas et al.(2013)Karatzas、Shafait、Uchida、岩村、i Bigorda、Mestre、Mas、Mota、Almazan和De Las Heras],以及FUNSD[Jaume et al.() Jaume、Ekenel和Thiran],由于印刷文物在文字图像中充当背景分散器,因此数据集是非主数据。 同样,WordArt数据集[谢等人(2024)谢, 邓 张 Wang, and Liu)和TotalText [Ch 'ng等人(2020年)Ch 'ng, 陈,和刘)因其包含艺术字体和高度可变字体而被视为域外. AMR数据集[Laroca和et.al(2019)]也被用作一个微调数据集,其动力是存在部分占用文字信息的光泽和视觉文物. 除了上述主要包含拉丁字符的域外数据集外,我们还进一步纳入了MLT19的阿拉伯文、中文、日文、朝鲜文、印地语和孟加拉语分区[Nayef等人(2019年)Nayef、Patel、Busta、Chowdhury、Karatzas、Khlif、Matas、Pal、Burie、Liu等人],作为域外和省外微调数据集,代表着知识蒸馏最具挑战性的情景。 最后,Copiale [Knight et al.(2011)Knight, Megyesi, and Schaefer],Borg [Aldarrab et al.() Aldarrab, Knight, and Megyesi],以及梵蒂冈密码数据集[Héder and Megyesi (2022)] 都包含在同样的理由中,因为它们引入了之前看不见的符号系统和词汇. 我们报告在以前描述的所有数据集,包括域内,域外拉丁语和域外省外情景中,这种微调战略的表现. 对于每个数据集,一个不同的模型和独立对十个纪元进行微调,并在相应的测试分区上进行评估.

blocks.en: In the case of multi-script personalized Text Recognition, we are only interested in the capacity of the model to integrate highly personalized data, hence, data that significantly differs from the original training distribution. We make use of the same latin alphabets datasets as in the previous section. Namely, we train a latin OCR model using IAM [ Marti and Bunke(2002) ] , Esposalles [ Romero et al.(2013)Romero, Fornés, Serrano, Sánchez, Toselli, Frinken, Vidal, and Lladós ] , George Washington [ Fischer et al.(2012)Fischer, Keller, Frinken, and Bunke ] , Parzival, CoCoText [ Veit et al.(2016)Veit, Matera, Neumann, Matas, and Belongie ] and the Latin split of MLT19 [ Nayef et al.(2019)Nayef, Patel, Busta, Chowdhury, Karatzas, Khlif, Matas, Pal, Burie, Liu, et al. ] .
blocks.zh: 在多写个性化文本识别方面,我们只关心该模型整合高度个性化数据的能力,因此,数据与原始培训分布有很大不同。 我们使用与上一节相同的拉丁字母数据集。 也就是说,我们用IAM[Marti and Bunke(2002)],Esposalles来训练一个LATIN OCR模型. [Romero等人(2013年)、Romero、Fornés、Serrano、Sánchez、Toselli、Frinken、Vidal和Lladós]、George Washington[Fischer等人(2012年)Fischer、Keller、Frinken和Bunke]、Parzival、CoCoText[Veit等人(2016年)Veit、Matera、Neumann、Matas和Unitie]和MLT19的拉丁分裂[Nayef等人(2019年)Nayef、Patel、Busta、Cowdhury、Karatzas、Khlif、Matas、Pal、Burie、Lu等人]。

blocks.en: Because of Latin Out-of-Distribution data constitutes nothing but an extension of the original training data, we only consider non-latin alphabets as suitable for a personalized learning evaluation. We include fine-tuning on the Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, and Bangla partitions of MLT19 [ Nayef et al.(2019)Nayef, Patel, Busta, Chowdhury, Karatzas, Khlif, Matas, Pal, Burie, Liu, et al. ] and the Copiale [ Knight et al.(2011)Knight, Megyesi, and Schaefer ] , Borg [ Aldarrab et al.()Aldarrab, Knight, and Megyesi ] , and Vatican cipher datasets [ Héder and Megyesi(2022) ] . We include both the performance for personalized OCR systems for every language and personalized approaches to multi-linguality (i.e. learning all new alphabets simultaneously).

blocks.en: We evaluate Table Recognition performance using a graph-based approach with two complementary metrics: node accuracy and edge accuracy. The model represents document structure as a graph where nodes correspond to semantic regions and edges encode spatial relationships between them. In one hand, node accuracy reflects how well the model identifies the type of each region. In our case, nodes represent regions labeled as either table or non-table. A node is considered correct if the predicted label matches the ground truth. On the other, edge accuracy measures how well the model captures spatial relationships between regions. This includes relationships within the same region, between regions of the same type, and between regions of different types. An edge is correct if both its presence and relationship type match the ground truth.

blocks.en: The main results of knowledge distillation for Query-by-String Word Spotting are shown in Figure 5 . For latin datasets included in pre-training, results are mixed: fine-tuning from distributed setups occasionally degrades performance, yet six out of eight datasets benefit from distributed pre-training in at least one architecture, yielding improvements in 75% of cases. Out-of-domain fine-tuning consistently favors distributed pre-trained models. Datasets not seen during centralized or distributed pre-training show clear gains, including for unseen alphabets. Performance improvements are larger when the fine-tuning alphabet matches that of pre-training, highlighting both the generality and limitations of the learned features. Overall, Table 2 reports an average improvement of 5% in mean average precision. In-domain gains can be negative, but out-of-domain datasets show substantially larger improvements across both Latin and unseen alphabets. Transformer-based text encoders achieve the lowest absolute performance, likely due to higher data requirements, yet relative gains from distributed pre-training are comparable to LSTM encoders, with an average increase of 6% in mean average precision.

blocks.en: Table 3 shows results for three training setups: (1) fine-tuning from a baseline trained only on HierText, (2) centralized pre-training on HierText and a multilingual dataset before per-language fine-tuning, and (3) the fully distributed version. We also include distributed learning from random initialization without auxiliary pre-training. We observe a consistent advantage of our personalized learning approach with respect the centralized and baseline approaches, with an average improvement of × 1.62 \times 1.62 in the best-case scenario. In some cases, such as the Borg cipher, distributed learning is essential for the weights to accommodate the inclusion of such a different domain. Needless to say, as it was specified on previous sections, both centralized and distributed pretraining have performed the same amount of forward-backward steps on the same exact data; hence, we can only attribute the incapacity of the centralized approach to incorporate certain languages to the training regime itself. Additionally, we include results for multilingual training (Table 4 ). In contrast to the previous experiments, where languages were fine-tuned independently, these settings consider an optical character recognition system trained to learn all alphabets simultaneously. Under this formulation, we observe that the performance gap between centralized and distributed training regimes becomes narrower. Notably, accuracy for the Borg cipher is fully recovered. This suggests that distributed models adapt more effectively in low-resource scenarios, whereas centralized approaches are sufficient when abundant data is available in the personalization step. Nevertheless, even in these settings, the distributed approach outperforms the centralized model.

blocks.en: The results for graph-based recognition, reported in Table 5 , correspond to a leave-one-out evaluation at the dataset level. In this setup, models are trained on all datasets except the one indicated by the corresponding column. For instance, zero-shot results in the RLV column are obtained by training on M96, ICDAR, and Con-Anonym while excluding RLV from pre-training. Conversely, end-to-end results in the ICDAR column correspond to models pre-trained on M96, RLV, and Con-Anonym and subsequently fine-tuned on ICDAR. Zero-shot results, where no fine-tuning is performed on the target dataset, consistently favor the distributed approach in both node and edge accuracy. With partial fine-tuning of the upper layers, performance becomes mixed, while end-to-end fine-tuning generally benefits the centralized model, with the exception of M96. These results support our hypothesis: distributed models are most effective in low-resource regimes, either when no adaptation is possible (zero-shot) or when only limited data is available (e.g., M96). As data availability and adaptation capacity increase, performance progressively shifts toward centralized training, with partial fine-tuning representing an intermediate regime.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en: In this study, we conducted an extensive set of comparative experiments between centralized and distributed learning paradigms. Our analysis goes beyond the commonly cited privacy and security benefits of distributed learning, and instead focuses on identifying the conditions under which it also provides performance advantages. This naturally raises the question: under which circumstances does distributed learning yield the greatest gains? To achieve sound conclusions in the study, we have designed a comprehensive set of experiments corresponding to a variety of settings in terms of tasks, learning scenarios and datasets. In the Word Spotting experiments, where only the text encoder is trainable and the vision encoder remains frozen, results (Figure 5 ) are mixed when fine-tuning is performed in-domain. However, in out-of-domain settings, distributed approaches consistently dominate. This effect is particularly pronounced for GRU- and LSTM-based text encoders (Table 2 ) which, in contrast to Transformer-based architectures, achieve strong performance with substantially lower data requirements. For character recognition, distributed learning exhibits its largest advantage when languages are learned independently (Table 3 ). When fine-tuning data is abundant, as in the multilingual setting (Table 4 ), the performance gap narrows. In graph-based Table Recognition, contrary to our initial expectations, end-to-end fine-tuning proves to be the least favorable scenario for distributed models (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们在集中式和分布式学习范式之间进行了广泛的比较实验. 我们的分析超越了通常提到的分布式学习的隐私和安全益处,而是侧重于确定它也提供性能优势的条件。 这自然引起一个问题:在何种情况下,分布式学习能产生最大的收益? 为了在研究中得出正确的结论,我们设计了一套全面的实验,在任务,学习情景和数据集方面与各种环境相对应. 在Word Spotting实验中,只有文本编码器可以训练,而视觉编码器仍然被冻结,当在域内进行微调时,结果(图5)是混合的. 然而,在域外环境中,分布式方法始终占主导地位。 这种效果对于基于GRU和LSTM的文本编码器(表2)来说尤为明显,它们与基于变形器的架构形成对比,在数据要求显著较低的情况下,实现了强效. 对于性格识别,分布式学习在语言独立学习时表现出最大的优势(表3 ). 当微调数据充足时,如多语种设置(表4),性能差距缩小. 在基于图表的表格识别中,与我们最初的期望相反,端到端微调被证明是分布式模型最不可取的情景(表5)。

blocks.en: What overarching pattern emerges from these findings? From an architectural perspective, distributed learning performs best in scenarios with a limited number of learnable parameters. In Table Recognition, performance is strongest in the zero-shot setting, becomes mixed when only part of the model is fine-tuned, and degrades under full end-to-end fine-tuning. Similarly, in Word Spotting, lightweight architectures such as GRUs and LSTMs benefit more from distributed learning than heavier Transformer models. These results suggest that practitioners employing parameter-efficient architectures or operating under constraints that prevent fine-tuning can particularly benefit from distributed pre-training. From a data-centric perspective, distributed learning is most effective in low-resource regimes. In Table Recognition, the largest gains are observed on the smallest dataset, M96. A similar trend appears in character recognition, where personalization to new alphabets yields a larger advantage when languages are trained independently than in joint multilingual training, where data availability is higher and the performance gap diminishes. Overall, these findings (summarized in Table 6 ) indicate that distributed pre-training is especially advantageous for practitioners working with limited data or in low-resource scenarios.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果产生了什么总体模式? 从建筑角度来看,分布式学习在可学习参数有限的情景中表现最好。 在"表识别"中,性能在零镜头设定中最强,当只有部分模型被微调时会变得混合,并在完全端到端的微调下降解. 同样,在Word Spotting中,GRUs和LSTMs等轻量级建筑比重力变形器模型更能从分布式学习中受益. 这些结果表明,使用参数效率高的架构或在阻碍微调的制约下运作的从业人员尤其可从分布式预训中受益。 从以数据为中心的角度来看,分布式学习在低资源制度中最为有效。 在表确认中,观察到最大的收益是在最小的数据集M96上。 性格识别也呈现出类似趋势,对新字母的个性化在语言独立培训而不是联合多语种培训中产生更大的优势,数据可用性较高,性能差距缩小。 总体而言,这些调查结果(见表6)表明,分布式的预训对数据有限或资源有限的从业人员特别有利。

blocks.en: In conclusion, the question raised by the title becomes clear: decentralization in Document Analysis is not a universal prescription, but a targeted call. It is addressed to practitioners operating under low-resource conditions, limited adaptability, or stringent deployment constraints, for whom distributed learning consistently delivers competitive and often superior performance. Domains such as historical Document Analysis stand out as particularly well aligned with this paradigm. In these settings, annotations are rarely abundant, and data distributions often diverge significantly from those of modern, large-scale datasets. Decentralized learning offers a promising pathway in such contexts, further reinforced by the privacy and access constraints commonly imposed by cultural heritage institutions and archives. A similar alignment can be found in industrial environments involving privately owned administrative records, where automation is hindered by the sensitivity of the data and the infeasibility of large-scale annotation. In this regard, small and medium-sized enterprises, which frequently handle confidential documents without the resources or legal capacity to externalize a labeling procedure, represent a natural and highly relevant application domain for distributed Document Analysis.

blocks.en: Why does merging generalize better?
blocks.zh: 为什么合并更能概括?

blocks.en:
As an intuition, parameter averaging acts as an implicit smoothing operator over the loss landscape. Each independently trained model θ d i \theta^{d_{i}} converges to a minimum shaped in part by dataset-specific noise, directions that fit peculiarities of d i d_{i} but carry no transferable signal. Since these idiosyncratic directions are largely uncorrelated across the n n independent runs, averaging them cancels them out, while directions that are consistently reinforced across datasets, corresponding to genuinely shared, task-relevant structure, survive and dominate the resulting θ ¯ D \overline{\theta}_{D} . The merged model effectively behaves as a coarse ensemble collapsed into a single set of weights, inheriting the flatter, wider regions of the loss surface that independent minima tend to share, which is also the usual explanation for why flat minima generalize better. This is consistent with the pattern observed throughout the paper: distributed pre-training helps most when the downstream task or architecture leaves little room to re-specialize away from this shared component (low-resource, zero-shot, parameter-efficient regimes), and helps least when full end-to-end fine-tuning can freely override it.
A full theoretical treatment would require an article of its own; we want to note the experimental basis is comprehensive, in consequence, we position this paper as the empirical foundation such theory needs.
